definition: eta = P(anomalous) / P(incident). P(incident) from a flat-mirror reference run (rod group disabled, same stack/source) divided by the analytic flat-mirror reflectance R_flat.
uncertainty: dominated by R_flat (Au JC data + 50 nm MgF2 thin film), +-0.02; GPU real32 arithmetic adds <0.01
note: The flat reference keeps the Au ground plane and the 50 nm MgF2 spacer; only the 200-object nanorod group is disabled.
